description: Eventual domination of functions f and g along a filter l means f(x) is at most g(x) eventually along l. For natural-valued functions on the naturals use the top filter, so the inequality holds above a threshold.
signature: Filter.EventuallyLE.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LE β] (l : Filter α) (f g : α → β) : Prop
